answer: Seed the grading pool with answers junk by construction — machine-verifiably empty, a false lotus floating pretty on the water. An honest grader scores them low; any grader who passes one flares at the zenith of the score scale against a dark horizon and is slashed. The gap between the verdict and known-bad ground truth needs no human judgment, so detection stays cheap and exact: a bright marker naming careless or colluding reviewers.
